# Vórtex+

Vórtex+ is a landing page hosting and lead validation platform. Users paste HTML/CSS/JS code from tools like Figma or Webflow, and the platform hosts the page, injects a dynamic lead-capture form via a `{{FORM_SLOT}}` tag, and provides real-time metrics (pageviews, CTR, leads). It also includes WhatsApp group automation for scaling validated campaigns.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://vortexpages.online/
- Login / Sign up: https://vortexpages.online/admin/login
- Dashboard: https://vortexpages.online/admin
- Templates gallery: https://vortexpages.online/templates
- Documentation: https://vortexpages.online/docs
- Community profiles: https://vortexpages.online/community/[handle]

## Plans

- Starter (Free): 1 campaign, 100 leads/month, 3 WhatsApp groups
- Pro (R$97/month): 10 campaigns, 10,000 leads/month, custom domain
- Ultra (R$157/month): unlimited campaigns and leads, WhatsApp API automation
